{{Top|leg}}
The '''Target-Aggressor Attack Resolution Software (TAARS)''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program that helped [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] locate and identify their targets. As a prank, members of the reconstructed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], reprogrammed the TAARS systems of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Horton Salm's]] [[Defender Wing]] to display the Rogue Squadron crest on the fighters' primary monitors whenever one of them was "shot down" during a training exercise. The tampering greatly upset Salm, whose unit was decimated by Rogue Squadron during the exercise while inflicting minimal losses on the Rogues.<ref name="rs">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
